tasks.title: Add structured QA verdicts and score aggregation
Implement delta-only self-heal loop with three-round cap
Stream and expand persisted QA timeline events
Persist score badges and verify mock recovery journeys
Cover exhaustion, persisted score consistency, and parallel journeys
Add deterministic persistence assertions and repeat parallel recovery journey

pendingRefinements.problem: The concurrency statement does not specify whether it covers the isolated QA suite or the complete configured E2E suite; the QA suite passes at three workers while the five-worker full suite fails across QA and generate-loop cases.
pendingRefinements.suggestion: Require the complete `pnpm test:e2e` suite to pass at its configured worker count and report per-worker deviceId/project isolation.

pendingRefinements.problem: The tech design has no endpoint method, payload, malformed-input or ownership-failure contract, so API behavior cannot be independently checked outside the browser.
pendingRefinements.suggestion: Document the run/SSE and probe-facing endpoint contracts and add real-request checks for success, malformed payload and deviceId ownership denial.

pendingRefinements.problem: The live exhaustion view showed three repair rounds while data-run-qa-rounds was 0, and the current test pass did not prevent that discrepancy in this browser run.
pendingRefinements.suggestion: Assert that the persisted run qa_rounds equals the visible fix-event count (three on exhaustion) after a fresh workbench reload, in addition to asserting no fourth Engineer call.

pendingRefinements.problem: The pages.json workbench path is a literal template and harness capture's browser has no same-context project, so official capture failed for this page even though a separate real browser journey produced a screenshot.
pendingRefinements.suggestion: Have capture create a project in its browser context, navigate to its real workbench URL, and require a successful workbench PNG in the capture manifest.

pendingRefinements.problem: The independent browser probe covers malformed and unexpected-source postMessages, but the rubric has no deterministic assertion that separately counts rejected probe, verdict, and fix events.
pendingRefinements.suggestion: Add an explicit browser or unit check for each message class and assert rejected messages add no probe/verdict/fix event and do not invoke Engineer repair.

refinementLog.problem: There is no documented deterministic way to trigger a persistent mock failure and inspect exhaustion.
refinementLog.suggestion: Provide a mock scenario that fails through three fix rounds and assert no fourth repair call, the Chinese exhausted state, and the retained score/version.
refinementLog.note: The failed evaluation could not observe the exhaustion state. RB-8 now requires a deterministic persistent-failure journey that proves exactly three repair attempts, no fourth call, the Chinese exhausted state, and retained score/version. TASK-6 covers this verification.

refinementLog.problem: The full E2E check runs five workers and fails stateful generation journeys, while the QA spec passes serially.
refinementLog.suggestion: Add an explicit multi-worker run check or isolate per-worker browser and persistence state so streamed timeline journeys are stable under the configured suite concurrency.
refinementLog.note: The timeline journey should remain reliable at the suite's configured parallelism. RB-10 now requires multi-worker coverage, and TASK-6 runs the mock E2E at five workers.

refinementLog.problem: The browser-visible values can be compared, but the contract also requires the run and version rows to contain the same score and the tech design does not document a read API for checking them.
refinementLog.suggestion: Document a read-only verification route or a deterministic check that compares the persisted run and version scores with the visible project-card score.
refinementLog.note: REQ-5 requires the displayed score to match both persisted records. RB-12 now requires a deterministic repository-level comparison of run and version scores against the project-card score; the tech design specifies this check without adding a production diagnostic route.

refinementLog.problem: A ready status and passing QA verdict do not prove that the preview visibly rendered content; the observed iframe was blank.
refinementLog.suggestion: Require non-empty visible preview content after recovery, along with a ready status and inspectable repair history.
refinementLog.note: A ready state and passing verdict did not establish that users could see a rendered preview. RB-16 now requires non-empty visible preview content alongside ready status, final score, and inspectable repair history. TASK-6 covers this assertion.

refinementLog.problem: The browser-visible exhausted state does not prove that a fourth Engineer call was not made or that the final version row remains persisted.
refinementLog.suggestion: Expose a deterministic test-only assertion for Engineer repair call count and persisted final run/version values, and cite its output alongside the browser journey.
refinementLog.note: The exhausted browser state alone cannot prove the backend call limit or persisted result. RB-8 now requires deterministic assertions for exactly three repair calls and the final run/version qa_score values; TASK-7 adds the verification work.

refinementLog.problem: The visible badge and reload prove UI persistence but do not compare the value against both the run and version database rows.
refinementLog.suggestion: Provide a deterministic repository-level verification artifact that reports the same qa_score from the completed run, resulting version, workbench badge, and reloaded project card.
refinementLog.note: Matching badges do not independently prove consistency with persisted records. RB-12 now requires one artifact comparing the completed run, resulting version, workbench badge, and reloaded project card; TASK-7 adds the repository assertion.

refinementLog.problem: The criterion is binary in spirit but does not distinguish a passing focused run from an intermittent paint failure under the configured parallel E2E suite.
refinementLog.suggestion: Require the recovery journey to pass repeatedly at configured E2E worker concurrency and wait for both ready status and non-empty painted preview content before scoring complete.
refinementLog.note: The recovery journey intermittently failed to paint under parallel execution. RB-16 now requires ready status and non-empty painted preview content, repeatedly passing at configured concurrency; TASK-7 repeats the five-worker E2E journey three times.
